backgroundsAndUI.fontGuidance: Screenshot visually resembles a modern neutral sans with light (300–400) large headlines; original font file/name cannot be confidently established by raster screenshot alone.

qualityAndLimitations: Every raster file is a standalone extraction/reconstruction of photo pixels from the supplied composite screenshot; not a faithful original full-frame photographic source.
Upscaling to 3x increases file dimensions, not genuine optical detail.
Occluded source pixels cannot be recovered exactly. CV2 inpainting behind a circular control and vertical stretch beneath mood pills are explicitly approximate.
Transparent hero assets reproduce visible cutout silhouette only. For an independently scrollable hero photograph, replace with original photographer image when available.
No raster asset contains intended UI text, status bar, buttons or pricing labels.
Metadata coordinates are visual estimates; no original Figma/PSD measurements available.
